theme_strategy.rationale: High-density quantitative algorithmic trading workstations require low eyestrain dark interfaces with maximum contrast for green/red/amber signal indicators, microsecond timestamps, and candlestick rendering.

typography.font_pair_rationale: Barlow Condensed delivers intense, heavyweight athletic & tactical Bloomberg header presence. JetBrains Mono ensures zero layout shifts on high-frequency streaming prices, order sizes, confidence percentages, and consensus scores. DM Sans provides crisp legibility for multi-agent analytical evidence text.

layout_architecture.grid_structure: Desktop Tactical Split 12-Column Grid with fixed Header & Status Ticker

header_nav.style: bg-[#090D14]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1E2638] z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-4
elements: MIB-Trader Brand Badge (Cyber tactical logo + LIVE badge)
BTC/USDT Realtime Ticker (Price, 24h Change, 24h High/Low, Volume)
MEXC SQLite Sync Indicator (Synced/Lag ms/Candles in DB)

layer_1_market_data.title: LAYER 1: RAW & STRUCTURED MARKET DATA
components: Interactive Candlestick Chart (Lightweight-charts / custom canvas high-performance candle renderer with volume histogram, overlay indicators toggle, crosshair tooltip, timeframe selector)
HTF Regime Matrix (4h Trend, 1d Structure, Volatility state, Funding/Open-Interest context)
Key Trading Levels Strip & FVG/Fibonacci Inspector (Support 1/2/3, Resistance 1/2/3, 0.618 Golden Pocket, Active FVG Imbalance Zones)

layer_2_brain_consensus.title: LAYER 2: BRAIN CONSENSUS ENGINE (TOP COMMAND)
components: Brain Master Decision Hero (LONG / SHORT / WAIT / AVOID high-impact banner)
Consensus Score Gauge (-100 Extreme Bearish to +100 Extreme Bullish with zero-center bar)
Confidence Gauge (% score with breakdown of voting weights)
Traceable Reasoning Feed ('Why did the Brain decide this?' bulleted causal chain with agent contributions & conflict vetoes)

agents.name: Support & Resistance
agents.focus: Key pivots, Dynamic EMAs, Liquidity pools

agents.name: Trend Filter
agents.focus: Supertrend, ADX directional strength, EMA ribbons

visual_enhancers.active_signal_pulse: Continuous subtle 2s ease-in-out pulse on dominant brain direction
visual_enhancers.tactical_scanlines: Subtle terminal scanline overlay on background canvas for pro cyber-quant aesthetic
micro_interactions: Hovering an agent card highlights corresponding levels on the chart (e.g. FVG agent highlights FVG zones)
Timeframe switch triggers smooth data refresh animation without chart flickering
Consensus score bar animates smoothly using Framer Motion with easeOut curve

testing_attributes.mandatory_pattern: data-testid kebab-case for all interactive and vital display components

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.js / .jsx) with high data density, no generic AI-slop rounded cards. Use tactical Bloomberg/TradingView dark style (#080B10 base, #0D121B panels).
Strictly separate MARKET DATA (Prices, Chart, Sync) from 10 TA AGENTS from BRAIN CONSENSUS (Decision, Score, Reasons).
Ensure all 10 technical analysis agents display direction (LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL), confidence percentage (0-100%), strength visual bar, and specific evidence list.
Provide interactive features: timeframe selection, filter agents by vote direction, click agent to inspect deep breakdown & formula evidence, level hover sync.
Support mock/persistent API connectivity to the FastAPI backend serving SQLite candles and agent consensus computation.
